newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms 1.15 points in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms 1.15 points in dull trade.

text.p: The Slovak SAX index firmed 1.15 points to 166.42 on Thursday but leading shares on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) continued to show little trading activity.
Only 569 shares shares changed hands on the BSE main listed floor on Thursday.
Steel maker VSZ, which led trading with 491 shares traded, closed unchanged at 650 crowns.
VUB Bank VSEO.BV posted the biggest increase, rising 50 crowns to close at 1,300. But VUB traded only 50 shares which, brokers said, was too little to indicate any longer-term trend.
The most-capitalised issue on the BSE main floor, oil refiner Slovnaft, closed unchanged at 860 crowns. Slovnaft traded six shares.
Other blue chips did not trade at all.
Overall volume fell to 213.855 shares, from 222.819 stocks traded on Wednesday. The turnover decreased to 67.95 million crowns from 130.9 million on Wednesday.
Both volume and turnover came mostly from direct trades.
